Definition: from G4862 and G4748; to file together (as soldiers in ranks), i.e. (figuratively) to correspond to:--answer to.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says Mount Sinai in Arabia answers to the Jerusalem that now is, in bondage with her children. The word is about lining up in the same rank, like soldiers standing in file: Hagar's mountain and the present Jerusalem stand in the same column. It is Paul's sharp way of saying the old covenant and the present city belong together, and both are bondage.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul's picture warns me plainly: anything that lines up with bondage, however religious it looks, is not the Jerusalem above.
